entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-28
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • WPF app using CsWin32 fails to publish - GenerateTemporaryTargetAssembly project is not importing nuget props #51474
  • AutoRestartOnRuntimeRudeEdit fails in 10.0.2xx because of known Roslyn flow gap #51469
  • [release/8.0.4xx] Enable Nuget Audit #51466
    11.0.1xx

Closed

  • Unable to workload restore latest nightly #51400
  • The "dotnet" command is not recognized after installing 18.0 Insiders + 10.0 RTM SDK #51218
  • Please automatically include .net sdk version bumps in the VS release notes #51268
  • [REGRESSION] System.IO.Compression version problems for Net Framework targets #51304
  • [NETSDKE2E][Windows]With 10.0.100 SDK installed on windows, error "Workload installation failed: Failed to install 814fe26b23c58be5f7a479ed4eab816c-x64.msi. Error: 0x00000643, Fatal error during installation." happens after running "dotnet workload install maui" in CLI #51459
  • [release/8.0.3xx] Enable Nuget Audit #51465
  • space character in .NET core application name gives HTTP Error 502.5 - Process Failure error #12474
  • Mistake in version range for CVE-2025-55247 #51434

PullRequests

Created

  • Add "empty" to console template description #51473
  • Enable NuGet Audit for security vulnerability scanning #51470
  • Fix CA1869 false positive in top-level statements #51468

Merged

  • Add progress abstraction for installation library #51463
  • Add CA1877: Collapse nested Path.Combine/Path.Join calls #51456
    Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • Add automation for merging dnup to release/dnup #51447
  • Run PR tests in `release/dnup` instead of just `dnup` #51475
  • Produce `Dotnet.Installation` library package for internal testing in `dnup` ci #51472
  • Update versions .props based on the RC2 build #51414
  • Add CA2027: Detect non-cancelable Task.Delay in Task.WhenAny #51452
    Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers

Updated

  • Update `RulesMissingDocumentation.md` #51451
    Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • Add analyzer CA1517: Prefer ReadOnlySpan #51216
  • Respond to `dnup` feedback from prototype code review #51446
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #51402
    Area-Templates, Area-AspNetCore, Area-CodeFlow
  • Add source package for file-based programs support #51373
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Add alpha branding #50468
    Area-CodeFlow
  • dnup code review #50988
    Area-Infrastructure
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #51376
    Area-AspNetCore, Area-Format
  • Improve clarity of 'dotnet project convert' output directory prompt #51443
    Area-Run
  • Extract common PackageReferences for MSBuild tasks that ship in the SDK #51445
  • Extend CA1516 analyzer to detect cross-platform intrinsics methods with correct semantics #51455
  • [main] Fix dll detection in dotnet test #51264
  • Make S.CL builder DSLs more transferable #50685
    Area-CLI
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.2xx' => 'main' #51207
